scope: Supplemental source manifest for the additive v2 scenario corpus: the 11 complete documents acquired in the Issue #115 re-acquisition pass (nine NRC valve reports, the CDC/NIOSH dust-control handbook, and the current USACE EM 1110-2-3105). Excludes the two partial Navy volumes, the duplicate 1994 USACE edition, and the three unapproved optional NAVEDTRA candidates.

counts.note: 39 document artifacts = 28 frozen-v1 documents + 11 v2 supplemental documents. That is 38 underlying document families, because doc:usace-em-1110-2-3105-2020 (30 April 2020) supersedes the 1994 edition already present in v1 as doc:usace-em-1110-2-3105. Do not claim 39 independent sources, and do not claim the ~50-document target is met.

rights_method.nrc: All nine NRC reports use basis=site_permission with terms_url https://www.nrc.gov/about-nrc/site-disclaimer.html, fetched 2026-11-09 and verified to state that the NRC website is a U.S. Government work not subject to copyright, freely available for non-exclusive publication or reproduction for any purpose, with credit requested, and that permission for embedded copyrighted material must come from the original source. Because most of these are contractor-prepared NUREG/CR reports, the basis is recorded as the site permission, not as blanket federal authorship.
rights_method.cdc: public_domain_statutory, evidenced by the public-domain statement printed in the acquired copy.
rights_method.usace: public_domain_statutory, evidenced by the printed distribution statement in the acquired copy.
rights_method.per_document_ingest_check: Each report's front matter and selected procedural chunks were inspected: no copyright notice, all-rights-reserved line, or reproduction restriction appears in the bodies; third-party figures, credited illustrations, and quoted industry standards are excluded from procedural text extraction.
